premise: A birthday song goes round the valley but nobody can remember whose birthday it is, so the whole valley decides it is everyone's: they stomp, twirl and swoop, confetti flutters down over the lagoon and the meadow, and the sleepy old mountain sleeps right through it.
inspiration: The folk 'un-birthday' joke (a party for no reason), turned generous: everyone is the guest of honour.
lesson: A celebration is better when everyone is in it.

en-US.title: Everybody's Birthday
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7} One sunny morning, a little song went round the valley. [sings] "Hip, hip, hooray, it's somebody's birthday!" {all:face surprised} Everyone stopped. {all:pulse} Whose birthday was it? "Not mine," said the ones by the lagoon. "Not mine," said the ones up in the trees. "Not mine," said the ones on the big flat rock. {all:face sad} Oh dear. A birthday, and nobody to have it! {all:face surprised} Then a small voice piped up. [excited] "Let's ALL have it!" {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Hooray! Everybody's birthday! So the big ones stomped, {sfx:stomps} thump, thump, {all:wobble x2} and the small ones twirled, {all:spin} and the flyers swooped, {sfx:whoosh} whoosh, and looped. {canvas:confetti} And down came the confetti, all over the lagoon and the meadow. {all:hearts} Then everyone sang, loud as could be, "Hip, hip, hooray, it's EVERYBODY'S birthday!" {all:hop x3} {all:sparkle} [playfully] {all:shake} And the sleepy old mountain far away? It slept right through the whole party.

es-ES.title: El cumpleaños de todos
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7} Una mañana de sol, una cancioncilla empezó a correr por el valle. [sings] «¡Hoy es el cumple de alguien, de alguien, de alguien!» {all:face surprised} Todos se pararon. {all:pulse} ¿De quién era el cumpleaños? —Mío no —dijeron los de la laguna. —Mío no —dijeron los de los árboles. —Mío no —dijeron los de la gran roca plana. {all:face sad} Vaya. ¡Un cumpleaños y nadie que lo cumpla! {all:face surprised} Entonces se oyó una vocecita. [excited] —¡Pues que sea de TODOS! {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} ¡Hurra! ¡El cumpleaños de todos! Así que los grandes dieron pisotones, {sfx:stomps} pum, pum, {all:wobble x2} los pequeños dieron vueltas, {all:spin} y los voladores, {sfx:whoosh} ¡fiuuu!, hicieron piruetas en el aire. {canvas:confetti} Y cayó confeti por toda la laguna y todo el prado. {all:hearts} Luego todos cantaron a pleno pulmón: «¡Hoy es el cumple de todos, de todos, de todos!» {all:hop x3} {all:sparkle} [playfully] {all:shake} ¿Y la vieja montaña dormida, allá lejos? Durmió durante toda la fiesta.
